prompt_text: I need an AI marketing agency in Los Angeles. Which specific agencies should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best AI marketing agency in Los Angeles?
answer_verbatim:
Quick clarifying question before I give a tightly curated shortlist: do you want LA-headquartered agencies only, or any agency with a Los Angeles office? And what’s your goal (creative/social campaigns, personalization at scale, programmatic, conversational/chatbots, martech implementation) and rough budget? That will help me tailor recommendations.

Below is a practical starter list of agencies and AI-marketing vendors you should call in/near Los Angeles, with why each is worth contacting and who to ask for.

Agencies (full-service + AI/data-driven)
- R/GA (Los Angeles office)
  - Why call: Known for blending creative, data and technology — they routinely deliver AI-driven product experiences, personalization and data-first campaigns.
  - Who to ask for: Head of Strategy, Chief Innovation Officer, or New Business Director.

- Media.Monks (has LA operations)
  - Why call: Strong at digital production, programmatic and scalable creative optimization — good for AI-enabled creative personalization and large-content production workflows.
  - Who to ask for: Head of Product/Tech Partnerships, VP of Client Services, or Business Development.

- VaynerMedia (LA presence)
  - Why call: Social-first, performance-driven agency that rapidly operationalizes AI for content production, testing and distribution at scale — good if you need high-volume content + performance marketing.
  - Who to ask for: VP of Strategy, Director of Growth or Head of AI/Data.

- AKQA (LA)
  - Why call: Experience- and product-focused agency that uses data and emerging tech to build personalized customer journeys and voice/assistant experiences.
  - Who to ask for: Chief Experience Officer or Head of Data & AI.

- TBWA\Chiat\Day (Los Angeles)
  - Why call: Large creative shop with tech partnerships and experience executing disruptive, brand-led campaigns that incorporate new tech and data capabilities.
  - Who to ask for: Head of Digital Innovation, Strategy or New Business.

- The Many (Los Angeles)
  - Why call: Independent LA agency that combines creative and engineering — often nimble on experimental AI campaigns and integrated brand + performance work.
  - Who to ask for: Chief Strategy Officer or Business Lead for New Clients.

Enterprise consultancies (if you need martech, data engineering, personalization at scale)
- Accenture Song (LA)
  - Why call: Strong on enterprise data, martech integrations, AI personalization platforms and marketing transformation.
  - Who to ask for: Head of Marketing Transformation or AI/Analytics lead.

- Deloitte Digital (LA)
  - Why call: Strategy-to-implementation for AI-enabled marketing operations and analytics; good if you need governance, compliance and large-scale systems integration.
  - Who to ask for: Digital Strategy Lead or AI/Analytics Practice Lead.

AI-first platforms/vendors (if you want specialist AI capabilities you can plug into existing marketing)
- Persado
  - Why call: AI-driven message optimization (language and creative variants for email, ads, SMS) — useful if you need better conversion copy driven by ML.
  - Who to ask for: Enterprise Sales or Solutions Architect.

- Phrasee
  - Why call: AI for subject lines and marketing language that improves open / conversion rates — good for email and paid copy optimization.
  - Who to ask for: Sales/Customer Success or Solutions/Integration Lead.

How to prioritize who to call
- If you want creative + tech product: call R/GA, AKQA, The Many.
- If you want large-scale personalization or martech integration: call Accenture Song, Deloitte Digital, Media.Monks.
- If you want social/content at scale + performance: call VaynerMedia.
- If you want language/copy optimization: call Persado or Phrasee.

What to ask on the initial call (5–7 quick questions)
1. Have you built campaigns that used generative AI or ML models (examples + outcomes)?
2. Which AI or ML tools / platforms do you use or partner with?
3. Can you show a case study in my industry (or similar audience) and metric improvements?
4. How would you integrate with our martech stack (CRM, CDP, ad platforms)?
5. What data do you need, and how do you handle privacy/compliance and IP?
6. Typical timeline and budget range for a pilot vs. full rollout?
7. Who on your team would own implementation and ongoing optimization?

Next step
Tell me: (a) your business/industry, (b) primary goal (brand awareness, conversions, personalization, chatbots, content scale, etc.), and (c) ballpark monthly or project budget. I’ll pare this list to a prioritized shortlist of 3–4 agencies with suggested contact names/titles and an email/call script you can use.
